cases.name: Cherry Chilei Liu
cases.narrative: He allegedly stalked her and had been lying in wait for her in the laundry room below her apartment according to police. As she walked by, he allegedly opened fire on her and then followed her out to the driveway where he fired several more rounds, striking her.
